criteria.evidence: Measured by me at head over app/, components/, features/, hooks/, lib/, types/, test-utils/: 723 unused import specifiers across 259 files, 48 on CRM/Inventory paths, so 675 in scope. The worst file is features/chat/chat-bubble.tsx, which carries 27 pre-existing imports referenced nowhere else in the file. ATTRIBUTION CORRECTED: these were NOT introduced by head's newest commit -- I re-measured the same file at 31c3786a6 and at 31c3786a6~1 with an identical parser and both report 27, and the only import line that commit touched is a deletion (-import { MessageActions } from "./chat-message-actions";, the symbol having moved behind next/dynamic). They are leftovers from an earlier extraction: the hover-action and dropdown UI moved out to chat-message-actions.tsx without a corresponding import cleanup, and no-unused-vars being set to "warn" is why nothing caught it -- `grep -c '\buseRouter\b' features/chat/chat-bubble.tsx` returns 1 (its import line at :5), and the same single-occurrence result holds for DropdownMenu (:15), useQuery (:9), apiClient/isApiError (:30), getStatusBadgeClass (:38) and formatTicketKey (:39). features/notifications/components/template-preview.tsx has 55 (PageWrapper at :9 and Button at :10 each occur exactly once in the file). QUERY KEYS, which the criterion names explicitly: 94 leaf factories under lib/query-keys/ have no `.<name>(` call anywhere outside that directory -- e.g. lib/query-keys/human-resources.ts:72 attendanceHeatmap, :166 headcountTrends, :174 dashboardDiversity, :272 exitChecklist, each appearing only inside its own definition. RE-EXPORTS, and the barrel clause inverted by the gate itself: scripts/check-dead-code.mjs:286-291 returns RETAINED-BY-CONTRACT for any symbol in CONTRACT_BARRELS or matching FEATURE_BARREL_RE. At head components/shared/index.ts:12 re-exports RichPanel while all four consumers deep-import from @/components/shared/rich-surface (features/settings/organization/org-settings-chrome.tsx:5, features/settings/roles/groups/groups-panel.tsx:15, features/settings/webhooks/webhook-delivery-log.tsx:19, features/hr/shared/hr-ui.tsx:6), and features/employee-self-service/index.ts:3 re-exports MyAttendancePage while app/(authenticated)/me/attendance/page.tsx:1 imports the module file directly. That is exactly 'considered used merely because a barrel exports it'. NO ENFORCEMENT: eslint.config.mjs:20-23 sets @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars to 'warn' (not error) with ^_ ignore patterns, so none of the 723 can fail anything. And the one dead export the gate did surface was closed by a KEEP entry rather than a removal: scripts/check-dead-code.mjs:100 records hooks/api/offset-page-schema.ts:offsetPageContract on 2026-09-04 with a reason that itself states it is 'deliberately ahead of its callers and NOT yet wired to one'. A recorded decision is not a removal, and this criterion asks for removal.
criteria.blocker: 675 in-scope unused imports and 94 dead query-key factories remain at head; the dead-code gate retains barrel re-exports by rule (the inverse of the criterion's closing sentence); the lint rule that would enforce this is set to 'warn'.
criteria.clauses_failing: FAILING: 'Remove unused imports' (675 in scope, incl. 27 pre-existing in features/chat/chat-bubble.tsx left behind by an extraction to chat-message-actions.tsx), 'query keys' (94 dead leaf factories), 're-exports' (RichPanel/RichHero/RichQuickAction/RichSectionHeader/RichIconWell/RichPageContent/RichTone/RichWellTone in components/shared/index.ts and MyAttendancePage in features/employee-self-service/index.ts), and 'An exported symbol is not considered used merely because a barrel exports it' (contradicted by check-dead-code.mjs:286-291).
